inputs.modified_text: Tensions in Nigeria’s health sector escalated on Thursday as workers under the Joint Health Sector Unions and the Assembly of Healthcare Professional Associations protested controversial reform bills before the National Assembly. The demonstrators gathered at the Unity Fountain in Maitama, Abuja, and voiced strong opposition to the proposed legislation.
